title: Tank tracks follow the crest
summary: Two tanks climb, brake and reverse independently. Engine load and rolling noise follow each vehicle across the ridges.
stage: tests/fixtures/ridge-duel.tscn Track-dust comparison runs Bridgehead seed 3 with --focus-vehicle=tank,1 --vehicle-view=Behind from 193.4 to 196.6 seconds.
rationale: Matched stills show the wheel and track shapes. The road comparison shows how tread impressions remain visible through dust as the vehicle moves.
source_ref: 11d6794 running gear before, revised running gear after
attribution: Controlled in-engine sequence, seed 712. Record tests/fixtures/ridge-duel.tscn with Godot Forward+, --fixed-fps 120 and --write-movie. Blend two temporal samples per four for the 30 fps master. Both stills use the current stage at 3.95 seconds, with the earlier model from 11d6794. Photography and field recording credits are in tests/fixtures/ridge-light, assets/vehicles and assets/audio/tracked.
